title: 微软项目协作：问题不清先结对，任务明确后分工
topic: 微软项目协作：问题不清先结对，任务明确后分工

source.title: Why Collaboration - Engineering Fundamentals Playbook
source.section: When to Decide to Swarm, Pair, and/or Split
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 本课选取 Microsoft Engineering Fundamentals Playbook 中“When to Decide to Swarm, Pair, and/or Split”完整小节。内容说明问题尚不清楚时结对、任务明确且步骤可预期后分工，以及需要额外观点或专长时请其他成员支援。该页前文把 swarming 定义为三名或更多工程师共同处理高优先级事项；本课不把它泛化为所有问题都需要多人加入。原文里的 folks、prescriptive 属于口语/专业表达，批注解释其语境。
paragraphs: While a lot of time can be spent on pair programming, it does make sense to split the work when folks understand how the work will be carried out, and the work to be done is largely prescriptive.
Once the story has been jointly tasked out by both engineers, the engineers may choose to tackle some tasks separately and then combine the work together at the end.
Pair programming is more helpful when the engineers do not have perfect clarity about what is needed to be done or how it can be done.
Swarming is done when the two engineers assigned to the story need an additional sounding board or need expertise that other team members could provide.
translations: 结对编程可能会花不少时间；但当大家已经知道工作要怎样开展、剩余任务大多有明确步骤时，分开处理也合理。
两名工程师一起把一个故事拆成任务后，可以各自处理其中一些任务，最后再合并成果。
当工程师还不能完全确定需要做什么或该怎么做时，结对编程会更有帮助。
当负责该故事的两名工程师需要另一个人一起讨论，或需要其他团队成员能够提供的专长时，可以采用群体协作。
fullTextParagraphs: While a lot of time can be spent on pair programming, it does make sense to split the work when folks understand how the work will be carried out, and the work to be done is largely prescriptive.
Once the story has been jointly tasked out by both engineers, the engineers may choose to tackle some tasks separately and then combine the work together at the end.
Pair programming is more helpful when the engineers do not have perfect clarity about what is needed to be done or how it can be done.
Swarming is done when the two engineers assigned to the story need an additional sounding board or need expertise that other team members could provide.
fullTextHeadings: When to Decide to Swarm, Pair, and/or Split

notes.phrase: split the work when folks understand how the work will be carried out
notes.meaning: 知道工作怎样开展后再分工
notes.explain: folks 是口语化的“大家”；原文给出的分工条件是工作方式已清楚，且剩余任务大多有明确步骤。
notes.example: Once the test plan is clear, we can split the remaining checks.

notes.meaning: 一起把故事拆成具体任务
notes.explain: task out 是团队项目里的说法，表示拆解成可执行的任务。这里强调先共同梳理，再决定哪些可以分别完成。
notes.example: We can task out the migration together before assigning the steps.

notes.explain: 表示对原因、所需工作或做法尚未完全确定，不是能力不足。原文的 “what is needed to be done” 能理解，但较啰嗦；自然表达可说 “what needs to be done”。
notes.example: We do not have perfect clarity about the cause yet.

notes.meaning: 再找一个人一起讨论想法
notes.explain: 如果两人需要额外观点或缺少相关专长，可以请合适的团队成员加入；无需因为任务量大就自动拉更多人。
notes.example: Let’s ask Priya to be a sounding board on the database issue.

scenario.title: An unclear authentication failure
english: Maya and Daniel are working on a login failure that appeared after a token-refresh change. They do not yet know the cause or the right fix.
Maya suggests splitting the work immediately: she will inspect the client and Daniel will inspect the service. Daniel proposes looking at the same failing case together first.
They can decide how to split the work after they understand the failure and define concrete steps. If they need identity expertise they do not have, they can ask another engineer to join.
chinese: Maya 和 Daniel 正在排查一次 token 刷新改动后出现的登录失败。他们还不知道原因，也没有确定修复办法。
Maya 建议立即分工：她检查客户端，Daniel 检查服务端。Daniel 提议先一起查看同一个失败案例。
等他们弄清问题并明确具体步骤后，再决定如何分工。如果缺少身份认证方面的专长，可以请另一位工程师加入。

firstAttempt.prompt: 同事建议把一个原因不明的集成故障立即拆开，各自排查。请用英文建议先一起梳理；等做法和任务明确后，再分头处理。
firstAttempt.sample: Could we pair on the issue first while the cause is still unclear? Once we agree on an approach and define the tasks, we can split the work and combine our changes at the end.
firstAttempt.rationale: 原文建议在“做什么/怎么做”还不清楚时结对；等工作步骤明确、任务适合独立执行后，再分工并合并成果。

words.meaning: 结对编程；两人协同处理同一项工作
words.collocation: use pair programming for an unclear task
words.example: Pair programming can help when the cause of a bug is still unclear.
words.translation: 原因还不清楚时，结对编程可能会有帮助。
words.note: 这里强调一起处理同一任务，不是先拆成两块各自做、之后才同步。

words.meaning: 步骤明确、可按既定做法执行的
words.example: Once the fix is clear, the remaining tasks may be largely prescriptive.
words.translation: 修复方案明确后，剩余任务可能大多已有清晰步骤。
words.note: 在本课原文语境中指工作做法已较明确，不是“规定性”的生硬直译。

words.meaning: 多人集中协作解决一项高优先级问题
words.collocation: use swarming when extra expertise is needed
words.example: The pair asked a security engineer to join the swarming session.
words.translation: 这对搭档请一位安全工程师加入集中协作。
words.note: 来源前文将其描述为三名或更多工程师协作处理高优先级事项；并非工作量大就必须拉更多人。

words.meaning: 可以一起讨论想法、提供反馈的人
words.collocation: use someone as a sounding board
words.example: Could you be a sounding board on this design?
words.translation: 你能帮忙一起讨论这个设计、给些反馈吗？
words.note: 不是正式职位；指帮助你检验想法、提出看法的人。

words.collocation: split the work once the steps are clear
words.example: Once the steps are clear, we can split the work and review the result together.
words.translation: 步骤明确后，我们可以分头处理，再一起检查结果。
words.note: 本课的关键条件是先理解工作如何开展，且待办内容已较明确。

words.collocation: combine the changes at the end
words.example: We can combine the changes and test the story together at the end.
words.translation: 最后我们可以合并改动，一起测试这个故事。
words.note: 原文说工程师可以分开处理部分任务，最后再合并成果。

structure.original: Pair programming is more helpful when the engineers do not have perfect clarity about what is needed to be done or how it can be done.
analysis: 主句是 Pair programming is more helpful，陈述“结对编程更有帮助”。
when 引导时间/情境从句，说明在什么情况下结对更有帮助。
do not have perfect clarity 表示“还不能完全确定”；后面两个 what/how 从句分别说明不确定的内容和做法。
可迁移为：Pairing is helpful when we are not sure what is causing the issue.
structure.transfer: Pairing is helpful when we are not sure what is causing the issue. Once the steps are clear, we can split the tasks.

rewrite.bad: You take the client side. I’ll take the service side. We can compare notes later.
rewrite.good: Could we pair on the issue first while the cause is still unclear? Once we agree on an approach, we can split the defined tasks and combine our changes at the end.
rewrite.translation: 原因还不清楚时，我们能否先一起排查？方案明确后，我们可以分头处理已定义的任务，最后合并改动。
rewrite.pattern: Could we [pair on the issue] while [the cause is unclear]? Once [the approach is clear], we can [split the defined tasks].

cloze.prompt: Pair programming helps when the team does not have perfect ___.
cloze.why: do not have perfect clarity 指问题或做法仍未完全明确。

cloze.prompt: Once we understand the steps and the work is largely prescriptive, we can ___ it.
cloze.why: 工作步骤清楚后，分头处理明确任务才合理。

cloze.prompt: If we need extra expertise, we can bring in another teammate as a sounding ___.
cloze.why: sounding board 指可以一起讨论和反馈想法的人。

dictation.text: Pair programming is more helpful when the engineers do not have perfect clarity about what is needed to be done or how it can be done.
dictation.label: 听写 1 · 何时结对更有帮助
dictation.why: 听出结对适用的信号：不确定要做什么或怎么做。原文这句略显冗长，语法练习另给自然表达。

dictation.text: Swarming is done when the pair needs an additional sounding board or expertise that other team members could provide.
dictation.label: 听写 2 · 何时请其他成员支援
dictation.why: 听出需要额外观点或团队专长时，可以扩大协作。

apply.prompt: 两位工程师已经一起复现了身份认证故障，但缺少相关领域知识。请提出邀请一位相关专家加入讨论。
apply.sample: Could we bring in an identity engineer to help us investigate this issue?

translationPractice.prompt: 原因还不清楚时，我们能否先一起排查这个问题？
translationPractice.answer: Could we pair on the issue first while the cause is still unclear?

translationPractice.prompt: 方案明确后，我们可以分头处理已定义的任务，最后合并改动。
translationPractice.answer: Once we agree on the approach, we can split the defined tasks and combine our changes at the end.
translationPractice.why: 步骤清楚后再分工，并约定如何收拢成果。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们能否请一位身份认证工程师帮忙调查这个问题？
translationPractice.answer: Could we bring in an identity engineer to help us investigate this issue?
translationPractice.why: 缺少专长时请相关同事加入，而不是只因工作量大就拉人。

choice.prompt: 两位工程师正在排查一项原因不明的缓存故障，尚不需要额外领域专家。根据原文，先采取哪种方式合适？
options: Split the work immediately, before agreeing on what is happening.
Pair on the same issue while the cause and solution are still unclear.
Invite the entire department, even though the pair can investigate it together.
choice.why: 原文说在还不清楚要做什么或怎么做时，结对更有帮助；分工需等工作方式明确，群体协作则用于需要额外观点或专长的情况。

output.prompt: 另一组同事已经一起查明了数据迁移问题，实施步骤也明确分成了两项。请用英文提出现在可以分工，最后合并并共同检查结果。
output.sample: Now that the approach is clear, we can split the two defined tasks and combine our changes at the end. Then we can review the result together.
check: 是否说明方案/步骤已经清楚？
是否提出分头处理已定义任务？
是否交代最后如何合并或共同检查？
